query: What is the official language of Brazil?
answer: Brazil's official language is Portuguese. Article 13 of the 1988 Federal Constitution says: "A língua portuguesa é o idioma oficial da República Federativa do Brasil" ("Portuguese is the official language of the Federative Republic of Brazil") [1][2]. That was the first time a Brazilian constitution named an official language [3]. Brazilian Sign Language (Libras) is also legally recognized as a means of communication. Some towns have made other languages co-official alongside Portuguese, such as the Indigenous languages Nheengatu, Baniwa and Tukano in São Gabriel da Cachoeira [1].
